rationale: R13 removed the final compact-proof and same-process-stop discontinuity. G33 still requires the complete run identity promised before R1: not a list of historical verdicts, but actual current consumer products joined inside one clean top-level evidence package. Some events are inherently historical and must not be replayed: the already admitted GLM-generated capability and the explicitly bounded, terminated G31 live canary. R14 therefore reconsumes their exact bytes and causal evidence through current native consumers, verifies their complete source manifests, and labels them prior lineage. Continuity uses one newly bounded localhost LM Studio semantic-reading call plus the exact capsule/trajectory and read-only Chroma support. Mattermost receives no fresh authority or network reach.

falsifiers: Any phase is satisfied by an old verdict label rather than a current consumer product; the clean top-level lineage is absent or unbound; the continuity answer comes from model context or Chroma alone; exact continuity survives capsule severance; a distorted voice candidate becomes effect eligible; source-frame severance retains certification; empty readiness fabricates work or completion; a historical generated candidate is called newly generated; candidate self-tests are the sole trial authority; consequence severance preserves the learned sole maximum; restart replays generation or an external effect; Mattermost identity severance inspects body or reaches cognition; a prior G31 receipt is described as a fresh write; any credential, stable private identity, private content, secret or raw API response enters public evidence; a fresh Mattermost request occurs; a report PASS lacks exact evidence; an unsupported README clause is marked PASS; another gate/path becomes writable through root qualification; or preserved G22/G28 work changes.
scope_review: R14 may add final-integration MeTTa/bootstrap and one narrow Prolog evidence membrane; extend the existing development-root predicate only to evidence/G33/R14; add R14 fixtures/scripts/docs/evidence and FINAL_POC_REPORT.md; run pinned local PeTTa/SWI, one bounded localhost LM Studio call, read-only isolated Miter Chroma queries, and offline current Mattermost candidate calls over synthetic identities; and read/hash public committed G29-G31 evidence. It may not call OpenRouter, Keychain, Mattermost, Docker, remote network, private memories, or human emission; mutate Chroma; change controls, candidate bytes, trial cases, model registry, prior evidence, accepted registries, or user-owned G22/G28 work; or create/use ~/.miter.

cases.positive: One clean R14 root crosses current Soul boot, empty-context book continuity, relational repair, recurring receptive readiness, compact v2 development/trial/NACE, fresh-process restart, current offline Mattermost mock/identity/panic, and a hash-verified prior G31 witness before the separate verifier renders the report.

cases.restored: Restoring each exact participant in a fresh branch restores Soul standing, exact continuity, voice certification, learned sole maximum and authorized synthetic ingress.
cases.held_out: The book wording and relational encounter remain absent from behavioral dispatch tables; the final verifier scans for case-specific prompt/answer selection and treats any such shortcut as failure.
cases.unknown_malformed: Unavailable Chroma preserves capsule authority but reports semantic loss; malformed generated product/source hash is held; unknown event/provenance does not create work; stale or duplicate Mattermost input is suppressed; and uncertain effects remain non-replayed prior evidence.
